tasks.label: start Android Emulator 1
args: ADB=/home/zimoch/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb; EMULATOR=/home/zimoch/Android/Sdk/emulator/emulator; if ! "$ADB" devices | grep -qE '^emulator-5554[[:space:]]+device$'; then "$EMULATOR" -avd haggis_api36 -port 5554 -no-snapshot -no-audio -scale 1.5 >/tmp/haggis-emulator-5554.log 2>&1 & fi; "$ADB" -s emulator-5554 wait-for-device; until [ "$("$ADB" -s emulator-5554 shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done
